derivation:
by
  apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
  simpa [NumberField.RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap] using Algebra.coe_trace_int a
explanation: Specialize the compatibility of integral and field traces to K = ℚ. The trace from ℚ to itself simplifies to the identity; injectivity of the ring-of-integers coercion gives the stated equality.
